en.p: A function $f(x)$ that is increasing and differentiable on the set of all real numbers satisfies the following conditions.

box: (B) When $g(x)$ is the inverse function of $f(x)$, $g(2x)=2f(x)$ for every real number $x\ge 1$.

en.p: When $\displaystyle\int_{1}^{8}xf'(x)\,dx=\frac{q}{p}$, find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
